SELECT A.*, COALESCE(B.CNT, 0) AS REPLY_CNT, COALESCE(C.API_SPC_ID, '') AS API_SPC_ID, COALESCE(C.API_NM, '') AS API_NM, COALESCE(C.VER, '') AS VER, COALESCE(D.CD_NM, '') AS REVIEW_RQT_TYPE_CD_NM, COALESCE(M.MBR_NM, '') AS AMDR_NM, COALESCE(M1.MBR_NM, '') AS REGR_NM, COALESCE(S.SYS_NM, '') AS SYS_ID_NM FROM ( SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiMainDAO.selRequestList */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY A.AMD_DT DESC) rownum, A.API_REVIEW_RQT_NO, A.API_SPC_NO, A.REVIEW_RQT_TITLE, A.REVIEW_RQT_TYPE_CD, A.REVIEW_SYS_ID, A.REVIEW_RQT_SBST, A.AMD_DT, TO_CHAR(A.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AMD_DT_STR, COALESCE(A.AMDR, '') AS AMDR, COALESCE(A.REGR, '') AS REGR FROM KOA_TB_REVIEW A LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC D ON (A.API_SPC_NO = D.API_SPC_NO) WHERE (A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND (A.REVIEW_RQT_TYPE_CD = #{reviewRqtTypeCd})
AND (D.DEL_YN = 'N') AND (COALESCE(A.API_SPC_NO, '') != '')
AND (A.REGR = #{regr})

AND A.REVIEW_SYS_ID IN
#{item}

) A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT, B.API_REVIEW_RQT_NO FROM KOA_TB_REVIEW_OPIN B WHERE (B.DEL_YN = 'N') GROUP BY B.API_REVIEW_RQT_NO ) B ON (B.API_REVIEW_RQT_NO = A.API_REVIEW_RQT_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT B.API_SPC_ID, B.API_NM, B.VER, B.API_SPC_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC B WHERE (B.DEL_YN = 'N') ) C ON (C.API_SPC_NO = A.API_SPC_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (A.REVIEW_RQT_TYPE_CD = D.COMN_CD AND D.GROUP_CD = 'APIRQT1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_MBR M ON (A.AMDR = M.MBR_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_MBR M1 ON (A.REGR = M1.MBR_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = A.REVIEW_SYS_ID) /* [현대화] MS SQL Server 표준 OFFSET/FETCH 적용 */ ORDER BY A.rownum ASC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
